hr_table <- read.delim(
  text = hr_table_text,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    cohort = Cohort,
    model_group = case_when(
      Model == "CARDIAC-FM (ECG + Risk Score)" ~ "CARDIAC-FM+\nRisk Score",
      TRUE ~ Model
    ),
    panel = factor(Disease, levels = panel_order),
    adjustment = Adjustment,
    term = factor(Level, levels = c("Intermediate/Low", "High/Low")),
    HR = `Hazard Ratio`,
    lower = `HR 95%CI Lower`,
    upper = `HR 95%CI Upper`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    model_group = factor(model_group, levels = rs_model_order)
  )

fig4_rs_hr <- hr_table %>%
  filter(adjustment == "Unadjusted")

fig4_rs_multivariable_hr <- hr_table %>%
  filter(adjustment == "Adjusted")

```{r plot-function}
term_colors <- c(
  "Intermediate/Low" = "#F8766D",
  "High/Low" = "#00BFC4"
)

plot_hr <- function(df, plot_title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = model_group, y = HR, colour = term)) +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.45), size = 2.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
      width = 0.15,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.45)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = term_colors) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11.5, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12.5),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Hazard Ratio (vs. low)"
    )
}
```

```{r chs-rs-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
chs_rs_plot <- plot_hr(
  fig4_rs_hr %>% filter(cohort == "CHS"),
  "CHS Univariate Hazard Ratios (95% CI)"
)
chs_rs_plot
```
